notes: Four-door French-door bottom-freezer with Flex Zone drawer, ice and water dispenser and an inverter (BLDC) compressor. The parts list covers RF4267HARS/XAA; RF4267HAWP/XAA and RF4267HABP/XAA are also covered.

gaps: The spec table does not say which fan motor is the condenser (C-fan) motor.

Parts-list numbers not repeated in the cited manual claims: main PCB assembly DA92-00146A (115 Vac, 12 Vdc, 5 Vdc), inverter board ASSY PCB SUB INVERTER DA41-00614B, overload protector DA34-00004D (4TM445PHBYY-82), freezer evaporator assembly DA96-00843A (120V/230W) and refrigerator evaporator as...
Door switch ratings differ between documents: the manual gives the freezer door switch as AC 125 V 1.5 A, while the parts list gives SWITCH DOOR-F DA34-10120E as a 250 V 0.5 A slide switch.
Only the manual's refrigerator/Flex switch rating is used here.
The 1314 Btu/h (0.385 kW) compressor figure in the manual is cooling capacity, not electrical input, so it is not put in w.
The parts list gives no magnet material for the door magnet.
The ice-water valve is switched by main-board relay RY78 (manual p. 81) but no valve part number or rating was found, so the valve is not claimed.
The inverter board's power module SCM1101M is named in the manual; no KiCad or LCSC datasheet link was found, only third-party datasheet mirrors, so no datasheet is cited.
method: Two Samsung documents from one Internet Archive item, read as text from the PDFs on 2026-11-12: the service manual for RF4267H*** (page headers dated 2011-01-19, copyright 2010).
Page numbers below are PDF pages; the printed page number is one higher.
The service manual spec table names each fan motor by position (FRE, ICE ROOM, box fan, CIRCUIT).
The fan motors are listed under the names the manual uses.
The manual gives the starting type as BLDC.
The parts list has an overload protector and a relay cover but no relay.
The inverter board's power module SCM1101M is named in the manual.

comps.spec: Compressor MKV190CL2B/E01 (MKV190C-L2B in the service manual), listed as 115 V~ 60 Hz, BLDC; one per unit
Freezer (FRE) fan: BLDC motor FDQT06SS3, DC 12 V
Ice room fan: BLDC motor DREP5020LB, DC 12 V
Brushless DC box fan 3612JL-04W-S49-G51, DC 12 V 0.3 A
Fan motor listed as Motor-BLDC (CIRCUIT): FDQT04SS2, DC 12 V
Thermistors, all type 502AT: freezer, Flex Zone and refrigerator compartment sensors plus freezer and refrigerator defrost sensors; the defrost sensors are specified at 5.0 kOhm at 25 C
Freezer defrost heater (Defrost Heater FRE), AC 120 V 230 W
Refrigerator defrost heater (Defrost Heater REF), AC 120 V 120 W
Compressor overload protector (listed as Over Load Relay) model 4TM445PHBYY-82, operating temperatures listed as ON 125 +/- 5 C and OFF 69 +/- 9 C
Defrost bimetal thermo protector (F/R), rated AC 125 V 10 A, off 60 C / on 40 C
Defrost thermal fuse (F/R), rated AC 250 V 10 A, opens at 110 C
LED lamps, DC 12 V: refrigerator lamp 255-320 mA, freezer/Flex lamp 45-75 mA, side lamps, vegetable and Flex-drawer lamps; refrigerator lamp assembly DA96-00398F
Refrigerator and Flex Zone door switches MS-406-SS-01, rated DC 200 V 1.5 A
Auger motor case assembly DA97-05246G, 115 V/60 Hz, listed under the ice maker assembly
Door magnet MAGNET-A, part DA61-03769A, 5 x 7 x 18 mm, 1200 gauss (material not stated); one in each refrigerator door

Sealed system: compressor, condenser, hot pipe, back cluster pipe, dryer (molecular sieve XH-9), capillary tube 0.032 in x 118 in (0.82 x 3500 mm), refrigerator and freezer evaporators, suction pipe; R-134a charge 5.29 oz (150 g)
Main PCB with main micom IC01; DC 12 V and 5 V come from a separate SMPS board
Ceramic resonator clocking the main micom
EEPROM holding settings and option data
PCB relays switching the AC loads on micom signals passed through a sink IC; relay RY78 switches the ice water valve
Sink IC passing micom signals to the relays that switch the AC loads
Compressor inverter board with its own MCU, shunt-resistor current sensing and IGBT power module (IPM) SCM1101M driving the BLDC compressor; non-isolated 15 V and 5 V supply
